integrity: All facets are reconstructed from the full signed edge basis. Their Euclidean normals have squared norm m-S^2/(m+1), so parity determines which facet normals are longest. Opposite extremal facets certify the optimal radius, their linear span determines the incenter locus, and a monotonicity argument determines its exact endpoints. Opposite vertices certify the unique enclosing sphere. Independent finite LP checks are corroborative.
scientific_limitations: The result is for unweighted star graphs in the canonical signed-incidence embedding with the intrinsic Euclidean metric. It does not classify arbitrary trees, weighted graphs, or general affine models. The closed incenter segment and all tangencies are proved for every positive integer leaf count.
title: Star symmetric-edge polytopes have a parity jump in their full incenter locus
